topic: Chan AO-derived direct-light contact micro-shadowing vs naive unshadowed NdotL pore leak rig
topic_zh: Chan 孔径微阴影门控（Micro-Shadowing）对比朴素无微阴影直射光毛孔穿壁漏光
scope: Deterministic Danny Chan (SIGGRAPH 2018 Call of Duty: WWII) AO-derived direct-light contact micro-shadowing (V_Chan = clamp((NdotL + 2*AO^2 - 1 + w)/(2w), 0, 1)) versus naive unshadowed direct lighting (E = NdotL) and 64-strip solar-penumbra aperture quadrature across 17 solar cosine stations (NdotL in [0.05, 0.85]). No neural texture relighting execution.

robustness.name: Sampled 17 solar cosine stations self-shadow grazing rays inside normal-mapped pores without wall leaks

good_fit: Sub-millimeter direct-light self-shadowing on normal-mapped skin pores, fabric weave, and armor rivets in Call of Duty, UE5, and Frostbite
Explaining why 4K cascaded shadow maps cannot shadow normal-mapped crevices and why applying AO only to ambient leaves pores glowing in sunlight
Deriving the cavity aperture cutoff μ_cutoff = 1 - 2·AO² directly from the existing scalar material AO texture in 3 ALU ops
Replacing 64-strip solar-penumbra numerical integration with a closed-form linear saturate ramp
not_for: Macroscopic building or tree shadows already resolved by cascaded shadow maps or ray-traced shadows
Completely flat unoccluded surfaces where material AO = 1.0 everywhere
Neural intrinsic image decomposition or AI relighting networks
Purely ambient overcast scenes with zero directional or analytical lights
